turns.prompt_text: Can you see the videos in this webpage? https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/5758-brain-nutrition-for-creatives-eat-for-innovation-flow/units/21133-strategic-eating-for-creative-flow
turns.response_html:
Yes, I can see the list of videos (lessons) for Unit 3: "Strategic Eating for Creative Flow" on the web page.

Here are the video titles and their approximate lengths:

  • The Ultimate Brain Food List – 5 minutes, 46 seconds
  • Neurotransmitters On the Plate – 5 minutes, 13 seconds
  • Circadian Nutrition: Timing the Meals with Creative Rhythms – 4 minutes, 8 seconds
  • Mood-Based Eating: Fuel or Wind Down? – 5 minutes, 17 seconds
  • ADHD Brain and Nutrition – 5 minutes, 45 seconds

Would you like me to provide a summary of any of these video topics?

That sounds like a fascinating course! Based on the summaries available for the videos in Unit 3, here is a breakdown of what each one covers:

🧠 Strategic Eating for Creative Flow

  • The Ultimate Brain Food List (5 min, 46 sec)

    • This video dives into the essential nutrients your brain needs to function at full capacity for creative work.
    • It presents the "Ultimate Brain Food List" of foods that support cognitive function.
    • The goal is to provide the right nutrients for tasks like writing, designing, and building.

  • Neurotransmitters On the Plate (5 min, 13 sec)

    • This lesson focuses on the chemical impact of food on your brain.
    • It explains how the foods from the list influence your brain chemistry and neurotransmitters.

  • Circadian Nutrition: Timing the Meals with Creative Rhythms (4 min, 8 sec)

    • This video emphasizes the importance of when you eat in addition to what you eat.
    • It teaches you about Circadian Nutrition, which is syncing your meals with your body's natural 24-hour rhythm, or circadian clock.
    • The goal is to enhance creativity by timing your meals to your natural creative rhythms.

  • Mood-Based Eating: Fuel or Wind Down? (5 min, 17 sec)

    • The lesson shows you how to use food to modulate your state of mind.
    • You will learn to use food to bring about states of alertness, calm, focus, or inspiration.
    • It offers strategies for when you feel foggy, distracted, or sluggish and need your brain to "turn on".

  • ADHD Brain and Nutrition (5 min, 45 sec)

    • This video addresses how nutrition can be a supportive tool for the ADHD brain.
    • It explores how food can help regulate focus, energy, and mood for people with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder.
    • The lesson provides tailored strategies to enhance mental resilience for those with ADHD.

Would you like to know more about the Tasks or Additional Resources listed below the videos, such as the "Brain Food Cheat Sheet"?
